user.title: Choose your UPS
user.description: Only UPS units seen by a Bluetooth adapter or proxy are listed. Disconnect any phone from the UPS first: it accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? Home Assistant will keep the UPS's only Bluetooth connection while the integration is running.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device. Make sure no phone or other app is connected to the UPS (it accepts only one Bluetooth connection) and that it is in range, then try again.
error.not_supported: The device answered, but not like a BestEn SC-160 UPS. Pick a different device.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported UPS.
abort.no_devices_found: No BestEn SC-160 UPS seen over Bluetooth. A UPS stops advertising while a phone, PC app or other tool is connected to it: disconnect it, wait about a minute, and try again. Also check that a Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range (Settings → Bluetooth → Advertisement monitor: look for a device with service FFE0).

init.title: Options
init.description: Describe the battery connected to the UPS so the integration can estimate the runtime.

data_description.battery_capacity_ah: From the battery label, e.g. 30 Ah. Set 0 to turn off the runtime estimate.
data_description.battery_bms: Only matters for LiFePO4. Without a BMS the estimate is more conservative.
data_description.typical_load_w: Power drawn by your devices, used for the runtime estimate until the UPS measures it during the next power outage (it can only measure the load on battery). 0 = wait for an outage.

battery.title: Battery details
battery.description: Rated energy: {rated_wh} Wh. With the suggested values about {usable_wh} Wh is usable before the UPS cuts off (suggested usable share for this battery: {default_pct} %).

data_description.battery_voltage: 12.8 V for a 4-cell LiFePO4, 12 V for lead-acid (AGM/GEL).
data_description.battery_usable_pct: Lower it for an old battery or a cold location.
